asset_name: Solar Nomad Disc Launcher and Disc
creator: SKOOSH project
notes: Locally authored geometry and deterministic procedural PBR maps only.
No downloaded models, textures, generation services, or paid assets were used.
The editable source retains named parts, bevel modifiers, UVs, DiscRotor, ChargeCore, and MuzzleSocket.
The runtime launcher preserves articulated groups while consolidating static geometry by material and parent group.
The projectile GLB is exported from the same charge geometry that visibly seats in the launcher.
The authoritative projectile converges from a modeled muzzle position toward the center reticle.
